items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: But we never got to Toledo, his home, I don't know why.

ctx.x: A little, 'cause I had been with the GF + I could sing harmonies, but like I wasn't a showman see Slim, I mean how do you follow him. Not me... Not at that particular time. But I wound up being another Redd Foxx and everything else. Tell jokes, dance, sing do everything else.
How did you travel with Tatum?

Train. We didn't do that much traveling. We stayed at places so long. After the 3 Peaces I think we went to Cleveland, and played at a place called Chin's. I think a Chinese place. We even broadcast from there. We stayed there quite a while. But we never got to Toledo, his home, I don't know why. We went to Chicago.
